informal_statement: For \(0<\lambda<1\) and \(R>0\), \(A_{\mathrm{B}}\) has derivative \(2R Q_{\mathrm{B}}(R)\) at \(R\).
reason: `CMVBallCase.lean:535-571`: The formal hypotheses are \(0<\lambda <1\) and \(R>0\). The proof cancels the two angle-derivative contributions using \(\sin (\beta +a)=R \sin (\beta )\), leaving \(R\cdot (2Q_{\mathrm{B}})\), equivalent to \(2R Q_{\mathrm{B}}\) and \(R P_{\mathrm{B}}'\).
